preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 100000 and 1 <= K <= N for N, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is between 1 and 10^5, and K is between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, K in test_cases) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((line == '-1') or (len(parts) == N and set(map(int, parts)) == set(range(1, N + 1))) for line, (N, K) in zip(output_lines, test_cases) if (parts := line.split()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either '-1' or a space-separated permutation of numbers from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all((line == '-1') or (sum(1 for i, val in enumerate(map(int, line.split()), start=1) if val % i == 0) == K) for line, (N, K) in zip(output_lines, test_cases) if (parts := line.split()) and line != '-1')
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the number of indices i (1-based) where P[i] is divisible by i is exactly K.

postconditions.expression: all((line == '-1') or (len(set(map(int, line.split()))) == N) for line, (N, K) in zip(output_lines, test_cases) if (parts := line.split()) and line != '-1')
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the permutation contains exactly N distinct integers.
